## Materials and methods: data wrangling

```{.r code-line-numbers="|2|3-5|6-11"}
stressEcho <- stressEcho |>
  select(-...1) |>
  rename(
    "BasalHeartRate(bpm)" = "bhr"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    chestpain = case_when(
      chestpain == 0 ~ "no",
      chestpain == 1 ~ "yes"
    )
  )
```
